name: barber-site
description: SBS Cuts — static site + Cloudflare Pages Functions. No build step and no npm dependencies: functions/api/website-deposit.js and functions/api/stripe-webhook.js call the Stripe API directly over fetch() and verify webhook signatures with the Web Crypto API, and functions/api/apply.js calls the Resend API over fetch() — all without any npm package, since this project has no build command configured for Cloudflare to run `npm install` against.
